page_title: VIL 2-1 CEL | Villarreal v Celta Vigo 26/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
90+2' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' Marcelino has decided to substitute Alberto Moleiro and he is replaced by Thomas Partey (Villarreal).
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
86' Alfonso Gonzalez (Villarreal) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Ionut Radu.
86' The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
85' Here comes a substitution. Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) is brought on as a substitute for Georges Mikautadze.
83' Borja Iglesias goes off the pitch and Hugo Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) comes on.

79' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
78' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Alfonso Pedraza is replaced by Sergi Cardona (Villarreal).
78' Substitution. Alfonso Gonzalez (Villarreal) on for Nicolas Pepe.
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Dani Parejo (Villarreal) coming on for Pape Gueye.
76' Alvaro Nunez (Celta Vigo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hugo Alvarez.
76' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Hugo Sotelo will be replaced by Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) replaces Marcos Alonso.
76' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
74' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
73' 2 - 1 Goal! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Arnau Tenas into the top left corner.
73' Celta Vigo will get another bite of the cherry as the referee indicates the penalty must be taken again!
73' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
71' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Arnau Tenas leaps out to thwart his attempt.
71' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is going to take the penalty!
70' It is going to be a penalty! The referee blows his whistle and points towards the penalty spot.
70' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Quintero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
69' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
68' Villarreal fail to score from a corner as Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo) leaps to collect the ball.
67' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
66' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
63' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.

57' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Ionut Radu pulls off an easy save.
57' Fouls committed – 7:10.
53' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
50' The game is interrupted now, Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
49' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
48' Villarreal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
48' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Corner kick. Villarreal will have an opportunity.
47' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
46' A quickly taken corner by Villarreal.
46' Substitution. Pablo Duran will be replaced by Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo).
46' Referee Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) for his blatant foul.
45+3' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

45' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
42' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Quintero had an easy-decision to make.
39' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) but poses no threat.
34' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) takes the corner kick, but Arnau Tenas reads it well and stops the effort.
29' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo) is given a yellow card.
29' 2 - 0 Goal! Alfonso Pedraza pulls the ball back for Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
28' 47:53 – the ratio of ball possession.
27' Celta Vigo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
27' Renato Veiga (Villarreal) commits a foul and Alejandro Quintero immediately signals a free kick.
26' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
22' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
18' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.

15' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
14' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Alejandro Quintero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
13' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
12' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
10' Celta Vigo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
10' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) takes the corner.
9' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) is adjudged offside.
7' The referee blows his whistle after Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
2' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Ionut Radu no chance!
2' The attendance is 16895.
2' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
1' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle. Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) commits a foul after dangerous play. The referee points to the penalty spot. Villarreal are awarded a penalty kick!
1' The first half has just begun.
Celta Vigo will kick the game off.
Alejandro Quintero is the one to supervise the game today.
